7390.title: Unsupported reasoning effort breaks Codex helper requests
7390.rootCauseOneLine: Helper HTTP requests force none even when the service permits low only; a 403 becomes a terminal request_failed result.
7390.proposedFix: Use low reasoning for the existing helper models without expanding generic permission retries; add the client-boundary regression.
7390.caveats: Reproduced twice against production code with a policy-enforcing HTTP stub and synthetic credentials, not the reporter's live workspace. The full regression patch is embedded in the report.
